You have to make a cut and move on at some point, so removal of sdk 2.0 is a legit step for the future of vrchat.
However, it would be nice to simply "2.0 SDK is legacy now and you can only update already uploaded content, but not creating new one", meaning like you have a middle step.
For avatars 3.0 and 2.0 dont make much difference in my opinion (i worked with both) - as soon as stuff might get more complex, doing it in 3.0 is way easier. As for 2.0 - 3.0 have a lot of user made tools by now to help the creation of an avatar and makes it pretty easy.
And finally to quote you
"for me most stuff that 3.0 can do its compleatly unnessesary for me sence i can mimic them in 2.0"
Yes, that may be the case for you. I for example would be very limited with 2.0.

details: to all vrchat team. you guys make a big mistake by removeing sdk 2.0 becauce there are ppl that want to work on models and cant do complicated stuff like 3.0 does and there are also ppl who prefair to work with the 2.0 or even hate the 3.0 sdk for verious reasons plus not to mension its not user friendly in any regards and many other things plus the 3.0 is still in massive developmend and is performance heavy to a high point i even tested the factor in many diffrent ways and even for me most stuff that 3.0 can do its compleatly unnessesary for me sence i can mimic them in 2.0 without any problems and also 3.0 haves a huge draw back what 2.0 never does and dont come with 2.0 is broken and all that thats compleatly bs becauce i have no problems with it and dont see any errors with it and if someone showd m errors that it haves then its not the sdks fault its the one who made the model and uploaded it. #2.0stays4ever
